pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Present Notas de Bolsillo as a personal workspace, not a landing page. The index helps selection; the sheet holds writing; the blue tab connects them.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express the brief's project intent rather than inventing a corporate mission. Favor finding, writing and explicit saving over promotional claims or promises of permanent access.

examples.text: Un espacio sencillo para encontrar una nota y escribir sin distracciones.
examples.title: Working intent

examples.text: Dos páginas: Inicio para el resumen y Notas para la lista y el editor.
examples.title: Scope statement

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, continuity and honest feedback as proposed design principles. Show them through visible labels, preserved context and server-confirmed states, not abstract value badges.

examples.text: Use «Guardar nota», not «Listo». Name the action rather than implying an outcome.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: «Volver a la lista» retains the selected note, search and scroll position in the planned mobile flow.
examples.title: Continuity

examples.text: Use «Resultado incierto» when confirmation is missing. Never replace it with «Guardado» for reassurance.
examples.title: Honesty

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in direct, calm Spanish. Use sentence case, concrete verbs and a useful next step. Avoid sales language, blame, technical traces and exaggerated reassurance.

examples.text: Escribe un título para guardar la nota.

examples.text: No pudimos cargar tus notas. Reintentar.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the pocket-and-sheet symbol on a white field. Keep the symbol and full name as separate elements so the name always uses real typography.

examples.text: A pocket holds one upright sheet; a blue edge introduces the selection motif.
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use one large symbol and one compact lockup. Do not fill the divider with repeated marks.
examples.title: Section treatment

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The rounded pocket suggests a contained workspace; the upright sheet signals writing. The blue tab is the only accent. Preserve the supplied SVG geometry across all variants.

examples.text: Place the pocket symbol to the left of Notas de Bolsillo for app navigation and project materials.
examples.title: Full signature

examples.text: Use the symbol alone for the favicon and application icon, where the full name is available in surrounding metadata.
examples.title: Compact signature

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Set Notas de Bolsillo in IBM Plex Sans 600, natural case and normal tracking. For the standard lockup, pair a 32 px symbol with a 20 px name and a 12 px gap.

examples.text: Use the ink name beside the original ink, white and blue symbol on Clear Sheet.
examples.title: Light surface

examples.text: Use a white name and place the unchanged symbol on a white support surface. Do not recolor individual symbol parts.
examples.title: Blue header

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Define x as one quarter of the symbol's displayed width. Reserve at least x around the complete lockup; the internal symbol-to-name gap remains a separate spacing rule.

examples.text: Leave at least 8 px clear on every outer edge. Use a 12 px gap before the name.
examples.title: 32 px symbol

examples.text: Reserve 16 px around the lockup. Keep buttons, borders and the shared descriptor outside this area.
examples.title: 64 px symbol

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep the original mark unchanged. On colored applications, use a Clear Sheet support surface with safezone padding. Pair the name with a high-contrast background.

examples.text: Clear Sheet #FFFFFF carries the original symbol and Steady Ink #182B45 name.
examples.title: White application

examples.text: Selection Blue #2457D6 carries a white name; the complete symbol sits on a white support surface.
examples.title: Blue application

examples.text: Steady Ink #182B45 carries a white name and white symbol support. Keep blue for a small secondary accent.
examples.title: Ink cover

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the single SVG as the source for every icon size. Preserve the pocket curve, sheet fold and blue tab. Render at 16–32 px for compact UI uses without adding detail.

examples.text: Center the complete pocket geometry within its square canvas; omit the name and any extra frame.
examples.title: 16 px favicon

examples.text: Use the same proportions beside Notas de Bolsillo. Do not enlarge the fold or tab independently.
examples.title: 32 px app identity

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Never stretch, rotate, redraw or typeset inside the symbol. Do not replace the full name with initials. The pocket is an identity mark, not a repeating background texture.

examples.text: Do not use «NDB», «Notas Bolsillo» or all-capital lettering as the primary signature.
examples.title: Incorrect name

examples.text: Avoid gradients, shadows, emoji substitutes and a blue symbol directly on a blue field without its white support.
examples.title: Incorrect treatment

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans throughout. Build recognition with a consistent left edge, restrained weights and readable Spanish copy rather than an additional display face.

examples.text: Busca por título o por texto.
examples.title: Encuentra tu nota

examples.text: Set one short heading above a single support line. Leave the rest of the surface open.
examples.title: Divider composition

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Keep headings at 28–36 px, body and fields at 16 px, navigation at 16 px and metadata at 13 px. Use ink for small text; Quiet Edge is primarily a border color.

examples.text: Elige una nota para abrirla en la hoja de escritura.
examples.title: Tus notas

examples.text: Use approximately 1.5 line height for body copy and 1.2 for headings. Keep labels close to their fields.
examples.title: Reading rhythm

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans files are supplied for 400, 500, 600 and 700. The app direction uses local WOFF2 with the license retained; use the same family for Spanish labels and note content.

examples.text: Escribe un título y añade texto si lo necesitas.
examples.title: Una hoja para tus ideas

examples.text: Título · sesión · búsqueda · última edición · ¿Eliminar esta nota? · 0123456789
examples.title: Character specimen

pages.title: Weights & style
pages.summary: Use 400 for body and fields, 500 for navigation and controls, and 600 for app headings and the name. Reserve 700 for manual headings; avoid synthetic bold and decorative italics.

examples.text: Los cambios se guardan cuando pulsas este botón.
examples.title: Guardar nota

examples.text: Set «Notas» at 600, «Nueva nota» at 500 and «Texto (opcional)» at 400. Do not bold entire explanatory paragraphs.
examples.title: Weight contrast

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans 400 for timestamps, help and the shared descriptor. No secondary brand family is needed. Any temporary system sans substitute is a fallback, not the identity typeface.

examples.text: Puedes guardar la nota sólo con un título.
examples.title: Texto (opcional)

examples.text: Set the shared descriptor at 13 px in ink on light surfaces. Keep it readable but subordinate to navigation and actions.
examples.title: Small-copy rule

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Give each view one page heading and each field a visible label. Prioritize the selected note, its status and Guardar nota in one header; put secondary actions on a separate line.

examples.text: Cambios sin guardar
examples.title: Nueva nota

examples.text: Place «Título» before «Texto (opcional)». Use 16 px field text and 13 px supporting messages without weakening contrast.
examples.title: Field hierarchy

examples.text: Allow heading and dialog titles to wrap. Never truncate the saved text inside the editor.
examples.title: Long titles

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48 px spacing scale. Inicio pairs a narrow summary with wide activity; Notas pairs an index with a top-aligned sheet. Avoid commercial card grids.

examples.text: Give Notas a 320 px index and flexible editor. Align their top edges and connect the selected row with one blue tab.
examples.title: 1440 px workspace

examples.text: Use a 248 px index and a 16 px gap. Move secondary editor actions onto their own line.
examples.title: 768 px workspace

examples.text: Alternate list and editor within /notas. Use 52 px navigation, a 44 px return control and a sticky header that retains its space.
examples.title: 390 px workspace

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Use a blue-and-gray working desk with a white writing sheet. Ink carries reading; blue carries action and selection. Keep the palette flat and restrained.

examples.text: Quiet Desk surrounds Clear Sheet. Steady Ink keeps labels and note content legible across both surfaces.
examples.title: Workspace pairing

examples.text: Concentrate Selection Blue in the compact header, primary action and connecting tab, rather than every panel.
examples.title: Accent discipline

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five palette values exactly. The muted role is Quiet Edge for boundaries, not a license for low-contrast text. Error is a separate semantic token.

examples.text: Quiet Desk · background #E8EDF3. Clear Sheet · surface #FFFFFF. Use desk around the editor and white for the writing area.
examples.title: Background and surface

examples.text: Selection Blue · accent #2457D6. Steady Ink · text #182B45. Use white text on blue primary controls.
examples.title: Action and reading

examples.text: Quiet Edge · muted #77879D for borders. Error #B42318 sits outside the five-color palette; pair it with explicit error text.
examples.title: Boundary and error

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Use the supplied solid colors rather than creating a tint ladder. Separate regions through white and gray surfaces, spacing and borders. Do not fade essential labels or state messages.

examples.text: Use a white row with a blue edge and clear selected semantics, not pale blue text on a tinted background.
examples.title: Selected note

examples.text: Keep «Guardando…» readable. A pending control may lose emphasis, but its label must remain distinguishable.
examples.title: Pending action

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: The blue connecting tab is the sole signature gesture. Move it for 160 ms only after an allowed selection; reduced motion switches immediately. Never animate errors or hide draft replacement.

examples.text: Bridge the active row's right edge and the sheet's left edge. Other dividers remain quiet and structural.
examples.title: Desktop connection

examples.text: Repeat the blue edge beside the same note's header after switching from list to editor. Keep identity visible during loading and failure.
examples.title: Mobile continuity

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple, consistent outline UI icons at 20–24 px within targets of at least 44 px. Icons support Spanish labels; the pocket mark remains reserved for identity.

examples.text: Pair a pin icon with «Fijar nota»; change the label to «Desfijar nota» only for a confirmed pinned state.
examples.title: Fijar nota

examples.text: Pair the trash icon with visible text in secondary actions. Do not use the pocket mark as a delete or save symbol.
examples.title: Eliminar

examples.text: Use a search icon beside the field, with an accessible label that remains available when the field contains text.
examples.title: Buscar notas

pages.title: Imagery
pages.summary: Use no photography or cropped images. Let the desk, index and sheet create the visual story. Editorial mockups may use clearly identified specimen notes, never private user content.

examples.text: Use spacing and the pocket symbol sparingly beside «Todavía no tienes notas». Do not populate the list with decorative notes.
examples.title: Empty-state illustration

examples.text: A mockup may show «Ideas para el fin de semana» as labeled sample content. The actual visitor's initial list remains empty.
examples.title: Presentation specimen

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build references from blue desk surfaces, gray dividers, a vertical index and one white sheet. Reject scattered paper, stock photography, sales tiles and notebook ornament.

examples.text: Index with writing sheet: selection sits immediately beside its content, connected by one blue tab.
examples.title: Chosen direction

examples.text: Flat color, crisp borders, 4 px control corners and generous writing space. No paper texture, torn edges or heavy shadows.
examples.title: Material rhythm

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Design studies translate the same lockup, left alignment and single blue accent across digital and physical formats. They do not introduce extra app routes, services or commercial offers.

examples.text: Set «Índice y hoja» on the left, with a simple white panel on the right. Avoid fake statistics, testimonials or user-note screenshots.

examples.text: Use a small chest signature on a T shirt or one centered lockup on a tote. Avoid repeating the pocket symbol as an all-over pattern.

pages.summary: Design study: adapt the packaging format as a sleeve for blank project stationery. Use a white front, ink name and one blue edge; imply neither a physical product nor an app export feature.

examples.text: Keep the pocket mark above the name and leave the center open. Use the blue edge once, not as a ribbon around every side.

pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup wayfinding with clear arrival into the private workspace. Inicio is the entry point, and its real empty state leads to note creation without onboarding cards.

pages.title: Note controls
pages.summary: Design study: style shadcn controls with 4 px corners, visible focus and 44 px targets. Blue marks the primary action; pinning and deletion stay secondary. Preserve semantic accessible behavior.

examples.text: Escribe un título para guardar la nota.
examples.title: Guardar nota

examples.text: Keep Guardar nota activable with invalid fields. Show linked errors, associate them with Título and focus the first invalid field.
examples.title: Validation

examples.text: Use «¿Eliminar esta nota?» with the full title and «Esta acción no se puede deshacer». Place initial focus on «Cancelar».
examples.title: Delete confirmation

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: replace a receipt with status in the existing editor header. Show Guardado and a server-provided time only after confirmation; never add a separate success card.

examples.text: No sabemos si se completó el guardado. Recupera el envío original antes de volver a enviarlo.
examples.title: Resultado incierto

examples.text: Use «Cambios sin guardar», «Guardando…» and «Guardado» distinctly. Later edits remain unsaved even if an earlier submission succeeds.
examples.title: State sequence

examples.text: Let errors expand in normal flow below the status. Keep the selected identity and editable content visible.
examples.title: Recovery layout

pages.title: Pinning reference card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the return-card format as a small guide to finding notes again. It is a reference item, not a rewards scheme, membership card or additional app feature.

examples.text: Fija una nota para situarla al principio del índice.
examples.title: Vuelve a lo importante

examples.text: Place a pin icon beside the headline and a small pocket signature below. Do not use points, stamps, tiers or progress counters.
examples.title: Card layout

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Design study: use a simple project display sign, not a claimed venue. Place the full white name on blue with the symbol on white support; keep the descriptor secondary.

examples.text: Una app ficticia de Esteban para probar Constructor
examples.title: Notas de Bolsillo

examples.text: Use one horizontal lockup with generous margins. Add no address, opening hours, directional arrows or service claims.
examples.title: Sign hierarchy

pages.title: Notes website
pages.summary: Design study: keep exactly two UI routes, / and /notas. Inicio presents session totals and recent activity; Notas presents search, index and editor. Notes require real Turso persistence, not a mock fallback.

examples.text: Nueva nota · Ver todas las notas
examples.title: Tus notas, de un vistazo

examples.text: Nueva nota opens /notas?nueva=1; recent rows use /notas?nota=<id>. Mark Inicio or Notas with aria-current and protect unsaved drafts.

examples.text: Distinguish «No hay resultados» from zero notes and loading. Offer «Limpiar búsqueda» or «Reintentar» without replacing the current draft.
examples.title: Search and failure

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive app/icon.svg and raster application icons from the same pocket geometry. Use a white canvas for contrast and keep the full name in titles, not inside the tiny symbol.

examples.text: Keep most of the page blank. Use one blue edge near the heading; avoid watermarks beneath text or ruled notebook decoration.

pages.title: Project cards
pages.summary: Design study: adapt business cards as project introduction cards. Use the name and descriptor without inventing job titles, contact details, addresses or a published domain.

examples.text: Front: full lockup on white. Back: «Índice y hoja» in white on blue, with no QR code or unverified destination.

pages.title: Note prompt card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a gift-card format with a writing prompt. Use a white writing area and blue edge; add no value, redemption code, entitlement or commerce action.

examples.text: Place the prompt above a generous blank area and a small Notas de Bolsillo signature. Keep the format distinct from an app input screen.

pages.title: Stationery seal
pages.summary: Design study: use the unchanged pocket symbol on a white circular label for presentation stationery. Leave its safezone intact and avoid suggesting security, certification or a product guarantee.

examples.text: Center the symbol without curved text or extra outlines. Place any descriptor beside the seal rather than shrinking it around the perimeter.

pages.summary: Design study: keep recovery inside the affected view rather than adding a support route. State the problem, preserve the draft and offer a specific next action without promising lost-session recovery.

brandbook.voice: Español directo, tranquilo y funcional. Acciones concretas, errores recuperables y estados inequívocos. Aviso compartido: «Una app ficticia de Esteban para probar Constructor». Sin lenguaje comercial ni promesas de recuperación imposibles.
